description:
- Erection of a single storey lower ground floor rear extension in timber cladding
- Erection of a ground floor side extension in brick 
- Replacement of existing front upper steps to main entrance with new steps to match existing
- Replacement of existing front lower steps to lower ground floor with new steps to match upper steps
- New timber framed door to allow access to understairs bike store
- New boundary treatment to front and rear gardens (cast iron railings to front, render wall to side with no.5A and timber fence to rear)
- Associated landscaping works to rear garden

REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 0pt 6pt 0pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#222222;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">A scheme for the protection of retained trees on or adjacent to the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in accordance with BS 5837:2012 'Trees in relation to design, demolition and construction – Recommendations'. The development shall not commence until any such details are approved by the Local Planning Authority and shall only be carried out in accordance therewith.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 0pt 6pt 0pt;"><br></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b915b5a8-7fff-c504-c07d-10b511e48f70"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#222222;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: In order to preserve existing trees during building operations and site works pursuant to S.197 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, and having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020).</span></p>
